## The problem (K2 §7)

The exported `network.json` edges were thin: `relation` was a raw
predicate slot name on the compute-on-read path, `support` was the
constant `WEAKLY_SUPPORTED`, `evidence_count` was the constant `1`, and no
date, source, currency or named claim set travelled with an edge — so the
page could not say *when* a relationship was evidenced, *by whom*, or
whether it had ended (H-2/H-3). `sharing_partner_degree` counts risked
becoming drawable edges (H-4), source-stated literal partners were dropped
silently, and node-label fallbacks could still expose identifiers.

## What ships

- **One emitter, both paths** — `_emit_network_edge` in
  `exports/spine_export.py` serializes every edge for the materialized
  path and the compute-on-read fallback alike; a publishable entity-ref
  claim with no materialized row still emits (the claim is publishable;
  only the reconciled row is missing).
- **Named evidence per edge** — `predicate`/`relation` in words (the
  claim predicates unslugged — never a raw slot name), `direction`,
  `observed_at`, `date_kind` (`observed`|`undated`), the valid-period
  kinds + `valid_to`, `source`/`sources` as display names (never raw
  source ids), `currency`, `historical`, `support`, `evidence_count`,
  `evidence` and `claim_ids` (the full backing claim set).
- **Honest dates** — `observed_at` normalizes to ISO; the pre-P35.26
  epoch placeholder `1970-01-01` folds to `undated` (the spine-side repair
  is L3 CONF-06's — out of scope, named in the ticket).
- **Derived support** — `claim_lineage`'s declared `independence_class`
  joins via a guarded `EXPORT_QUERIES` read (absent on a pre-P35.25
  spine → honest floor); ≥ 2 distinct declared classes →
  `STRONGLY_SUPPORTED`, any claim → `WEAKLY_SUPPORTED`, `unclassified`
  never corroborates, `CONFIRMED` never emitted at this layer.
  `claim_weights` rows accumulate per claim × source — one source no
  longer overwrites another.
- **Snapshot-pinned currency** — `reconcile.weight.currency` per distinct
  predicate against the export's `as_of` (C1–C4 → CURRENT/AGING/STALE/
  HISTORICAL, worst wins); `UNDATED` when no evidenced date; `null` when
  the predicate registry can't weight — honest absence.
- **Historical marking is structural** — `historical` = bounded `valid_to`
  or ended bound-kind or HISTORICAL currency; the web `edgeTemporal`
  helper keeps non-current edges out of the default current view and
  visibly marked (`[historical — ended <date>]`/`[undated]`), faded in the
  static diagram AND the island identically (SIG-UI-037 — the list is the
  source of truth).
- **Literal partners, person-screened** — a non-entity `partner_ref`
  emits a literal partner node only after `natural_person_signal` runs
  over the literal text before any label/node is formed (§3.4 R-8); a
  person-shaped or unlabelable literal withholds the edge whole; a
  registry-withheld endpoint drops the edge whole.
- **Degree is a node attribute** — `sharing_partner_degree` claims attach
  `degree` + `degree_claim_ids`/`degree_observed_at` to the subject node
  and never reach the edge set; the static page gains the "Recorded
  partner counts" block (batch-bound copy NW-04);
  `analytics._typed_access_edges` shares the `SHARING_DEGREE_PREDICATES`
  exclusion so the focus degree counts exactly what `network.json` draws.
- **Read seam** — `reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_edges` gains
  `observed_at` + `valid_to` (`upper(valid_period)`) additively; live-row
  filtering unchanged.
- **Registry-only labels** — `_network_node` labels every node via the
  `sig.entity-label/1` registry: emitted label + `label_basis`, the typed
  `not_yet_reviewed` state, or the typed `#{hash4}` fallback — a raw
  entity id, source id or improvised source name is never a label.
- **Schema + copy** — `public_surface_contracts.schema.json` records the
  additive fields (incl. the `UNDATED` currency class); no new JavaScript
  — the island ceiling is unchanged; the deterministic-exact copy stays
  absent.
- **ADR-216** records the owned decisions; CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`
  entry; `test_p34_12_queue_truth`'s placeholder scan scoped to the
  `_research_queue` function it names (the module now legitimately
  carries `"unknown"` as the published valid-period-kind enum — the
  check's intent, not its file-wide bluntness, is what binds).

## Out of scope (per contract, owners named)

The backend edge fixes (epoch placeholders in the data, supersession
marking — L3 CONF-06); the label module itself (row 307); the island's
chrome/copy honesty (P34.15); the graph catalogue/T2 explorer (GX-08/09,
PLAN-11C); the republish leg (the republish rows run it).
